sloka: प्रहस्तादभिसंश्रुत्य देवो वैश्रवणो वचः ।प्रत्युवाच प्रहस्तं तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ।। ७.११.३१ ॥
transliteration: prahastādabhisaṁśrutya devo vaiśravaṇo vacaḥ ।pratyuvāca prahastaṁ taṁ vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ ।। 7.11.31 ॥

translations.english: The god Vaishravana, who was skilled in speech, having heard Prahasta's words, replied to him.
